supersedes: the 'not obtainable' status recorded in G3A_NATIVE_ATTEMPTS.json attempts A1-A4
what_changed: Free memory rose from ~0.5-1.5 GB to 4-6 GB after other applications released it, and OpenDoc6 was switched to the SILENT option bit. SolidWorks then completed whole-assembly interference detection.

hard_limitation.problem: IInterference component naming is unreachable on this SolidWorks 2024 install

late_bound_idispatch.note: plain IDispatch does not recover the members either

hard_limitation.consequence: Native pairs have a volume but NO component identity. Every pair is recorded identification = UNIDENTIFIED_BY_API.
what_this_does_NOT_permit: claiming the arm has zero native interference -- 'no pair names the arm' is a statement about the API, not about the geometry
excluding a pair as a self-pair because both unnamed leaves compare equal (this WAS a bug in the first pass and was fixed: 94 stow pairs had been wrongly excluded as SAME_COMPONENT_SELF_PAIR)
locating any pair in space (GetBox is also absent, so centroids are NOT_PROVIDED_BY_API)

attempted_workaround.idea: ARM-DIFFERENCE: measure the same configuration with the arm resolved and with the arm suppressed; pairs that vanish involved the arm. Needs no naming.
attempted_workaround.blocker: IComponent2.SetSuppression2 did not take effect on the top-level arm component (plain call returns without suppressing; the 3-argument config-scoped form is not exposed by this wrapper: 'takes from 1 to 2 positional arguments but 4 were given'), and the EditSuppress2 route was not reached before memory fell to ~100 MB under concurrent load.
attempted_workaround.reproduced: arm_resolved measured 94 pairs successfully in both attempts, so the measurement half works; only the suppression half is blocked.
attempted_workaround.how_to_finish: Run r2p_native_armdiff.py alone on an idle machine (>= 6 GB free, no other SolidWorks or heavy Python job). If SetSuppression2 still no-ops, select the component and call ModelDoc2.EditSuppress2() -- that route is coded but was never exercised.

what_can_honestly_be_said.cross_check: The offline CAD-mesh measurement (G3A_NATIVE_INTERFERENCE_RESULTS.json) DOES identify components, and found zero arm-involved interference in DEPLOYED_NOMINAL and SERVICE, and three arm<->saddle-placeholder contacts (0.001-0.319 mm) in the six stow-family configurations. The two methods are consistent in the sense that the stow family carries far more interference than the deployed family (94 vs 20 native pairs; 3 vs 0 offline arm contacts), but the native run cannot confirm WHICH pairs involve the arm.
what_can_honestly_be_said.the_20_deployed_pairs: unidentified; they exist among the four live top-level components and, per the offline measurement, none of them is an arm-to-bus or arm-to-wing pair. That inference comes from the offline run, NOT from the native run.

blocks: any statement of the form 'SolidWorks confirms the arm is interference-free'
